name: Juliana Stratton
summary: Juliana R. Stratton (née Wiggins; born September 8, 1965) is an American lawyer and politician who is a United States senator-elect from Illinois. A progressive member of the Democratic Party, she has served as the 48th lieutenant governor of Illinois since 2019. She was elected in 2018 and 2022 on a ticket with Governor JB Pritzker.
